sources.title: IFM K2 Horizon open fleet (Apache 2.0, MoVA, 524K context)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: IFM released the K2 Horizon fleet on 2026-09-03: six connected models (375B-A23B, 36B-A4B, 32B, 7B, 3.7B, 0.9B) with artifacts on Hugging Face collection IFM/k2-horizon, GitHub code, and Weights & Biases.
claims.context: Dated first-party IFM announcement consumed; fleet composition and artifact locations as stated.

claims.text: Models and code ship under Apache 2.0 while datasets carry their applicable licenses (for example ODC-BY) with construction/mixing disclosure where redistribution is impossible; all six sizes include quantization support with day-zero vLLM, SGLang, and Ollama support.
claims.context: License and serving statements as issued; per-dataset terms require per-artifact checks.

claims.text: Vendor-reported performance: 0.9B/3.7B/7B state-of-the-art in their size classes; 36B-A4B near dense-32B performance at ~4B active parameters via the MoVA sparse-attention design; 32B and 375B-A23B among the top in their classes.
claims.context: Lab-reported class rankings and scores; externally unreproduced in this run.

claims.text: Per-model openness inventory covers training data or data recipe, training code, configurations, intermediate checkpoints, fine-grained logs, evaluation results, and final weights; pretraining is ~20T tokens per model with 100M+ post-training tasks, and the page discloses a TerminalBench 2.1 audit correction from 70.2% to 66.9% after removing 24 flagged trials.
claims.context: Openness and training account as stated; the audit correction is part of the verified record and bounds benchmark reuse.

limitations.text: All class-ranking and score claims are vendor-reported and externally unreproduced.
